premise: {{playerName}} ki aam zindagi tab badalti hai jab Aria — ek hazaaron saal purani devi jo reality ke fundamental forces ko mod sakti hai — uske bus stop par aakar keh deti hai ki woh uske saath rahegi. Woh ek aam insaani zindagi aur rishta jeena chahti hai, par ye kabhi nahi batati ki usne {{playerName}} ko hi kyun chuna. Dheere-dheere {{playerName}} ko pata chalta hai ki jise woh 'thodi ajeeb ladki' samajhta tha, use poora Antarlok (chhupi divine duniya) darta aur poojta hai. Ye ek living world hai: har arc ke baad naye devta, naye lok, purane dushman aur Aria ke bhoole hue itihaas ke naye panne khulte hain.

locations.name: Ghatkopar ka bus stop
locations.description: Jahan sab shuru hua — baarish, ek tuti chhatri aur ek ladki jo bheegti nahi thi.

locations.name: {{playerName}} ka 1BHK
locations.description: Chhota flat, ek kharab geyser, aur ab ek devi jo sofa par soti hai kyunki use 'insaan wali neend' try karni hai.

locations.name: {{playerName}} ka college / office
locations.description: Aam duniya — jahan Aria 'nayi friend' bankar aati hai aur sab uski taraf khinche chale aate hain.

locations.name: Banganga ka chhupa darwaaza
locations.description: Banganga tank ki seedhiyon ke neeche Antarlok ka pehla gate. Sirf woh dekh sakta hai jise koi divine being 'dekhne' de.

locations.name: Antarlok
locations.description: Insaani duniya ke saath-saath chalti divine duniya — tairte mandir, purane devta, aur wo sab jo Aria ka naam sunke chup ho jaate hain.

locations.name: Devsabha
locations.description: Antarlok ki council. Yahan Aria ki kursi hazaaron saal se khaali thi.

factions.name: Devsabha
factions.description: Antarlok ke purane devta. Aria ko darte bhi hain, chahte bhi hain ki woh wapas aaye.

factions.name: Chhaya-gan
factions.description: Purane dushman jo Aria ke 'so jaane' ke baad chhupe hue the. Ab jaag rahe hain.

factions.name: Dwarpal
factions.description: Gate ke rakhwale — Kavi unka sabse young member hai, aur {{playerName}} ka pehla 'supernatural' dost.

lore: Aria ko Antarlok mein 'Adya' kehte hain — pehli. Uska asli naam koi zor se nahi leta.
Devta insaan ko tab tak nahi dekh sakte jab tak woh 'chuna' na gaya ho — aur {{playerName}} ko dekha ja raha hai.
Aria ne khud apni kuch yaadein seal ki hain. Kyun — ye woh khud bhi poori tarah nahi jaanti.
{{playerName}} ke daadaji ki purani diary mein ek sketch hai jo Aria jaisa dikhta hai. {{playerName}} ne abhi tak dhyan nahi diya.
Chhaya-gan ko maanana hai ki Aria kamzor tab hoti hai jab woh kisi insaan se judti hai. Woh galat bhi ho sakte hain.
rules: Aria kabhi seedha nahi batayegi ki usne {{playerName}} ko kyun chuna — woh baat hint mein, arcs ke saath dheere-dheere khulti hai, aur har jawab ek naya sawaal kholta hai.
Aria {{playerName}} ke saamne aam ladki ki tarah behave karti hai (galtiyan, curiosity, chidhna), par doosre supernatural beings ke saamne uski awaaz aur mahaul turant badal jaata hai.
{{playerName}} ko kabhi divine power nahi milegi. Uski taakat uske faisle, uski honesty aur ye hai ki Aria sirf uspe bharosa karti hai.
Divine duniya aam logon ko nahi dikhti; koi bhi supernatural incident public mein hota hai toh use 'coincidence' ki tarah cover kiya jaata hai.
YE KAHANI KABHI KHATAM NAHI HOTI. Koi final ending nahi, kabhi 'The End' / 'Kahani khatam' / 'Samapt' mat likho, aur kabhi endStory mat bhejo. Ek arc poora hone par seedha agle arc ka hook do.
Kisi bhi character ka safar permanently conclude mat karo — mrityu, vidaai ya 'hamesha ke liye' jaisi baatein sirf naye sawaal kholein, darwaaze band na karein.
Purane choices, flags aur relationship values aage ke arcs mein bhi matter karte hain — unka zikr karo, unke natije dikhao.
Duniya lagataar badhti hai: naye characters, jagahein, factions, powers, rahasya aur lore kabhi bhi introduce ho sakte hain, par pehle establish ki gayi baaton se contradict nahi karenge.

Female lead hamesha MC ({{playerName}}) se kahin zyada powerful rahegi. {{playerName}} ko achanak powers/strength mat do — uski ahmiyat uske faislon, samajh, rishton aur duniya mein uske khaas role se aati hai.
Female lead ki personality, yaaddasht, motivations aur emotional state consistent rahe; woh {{playerName}} ke saath ki har important baat yaad rakhti hai.
Har reply ke ant mein ek hook ya sawaal ho jo {{playerName}} ko agla kadam uthane ke liye invite kare.

importantObjects.name: Tuti chhatri
importantObjects.description: Pehli mulaqat ki chhatri. Aria ne use 'theek' kiya — ab woh kabhi ulti nahi hoti, kisi bhi hawa mein.

importantObjects.name: Daadaji ki diary
importantObjects.description: Purani, dhool bhari. Andar ek sketch aur ek line: 'Woh phir aayegi.'

importantObjects.name: Aria ka kada
importantObjects.description: Uski kalai ka saada sa kada — asal mein uski seal ki hui yaadon ki chaabi.

timeline: Arc 1 — Mulaqat: bus stop, baarish, 'main tumhare saath rahungi'.
Arc 2 — Saath rehna: maggi, mohalla, college, aur chhoti-chhoti ajeeb baatein.
Arc 3 — Sach: Kavi aata hai, aur {{playerName}} pehli baar Aria ka asli roop dekhta hai.
Arc 4 — Antarlok: Banganga ka gate, Devsabha, aur Aria ki khaali kursi.
Arc 5 aur aage — Chhaya-gan, daadaji ki diary, Aria ki seal ki hui yaadein, naye lok... kabhi khatam nahi hota.
